df40faces.description: Faces whose fakes come from the DF40 test split, covering 40 manipulation techniques. Held out entirely for reporting.

stream_comparison.note: spatial beats frequency by 0.0518 AUC; not significant at p=0.2780 (the 95% CI on the difference includes zero) -- consistent with the two streams performing about the same

provenance_stream.note: Stream D reads C2PA manifests and generator metadata. Neither corpus ships images carrying either, so no AUC can be computed for it here. That is a property of the evaluation data, not evidence the stream does not work — but it does mean its fusion weight cannot be derived from measurement, so it is excluded from weighted fusion and used only through its override path.
